                                                                client: SYNCHRO.S writes the ratio/time limit into the
                                                            client (arr-style) and lets it enforce — it shows in the
                                                            client's share-limit dialog and works even when SYNCHRO.S is
                                                            off.
                                                        

                                                            

                                                                Per-indexer overrides
                                                                
                                                            

                                                            
                                                                Sonarr/Radarr put seed rules on the indexer, not
                                                                globally — a private tracker needs a ratio or a
                                                                week of seeding, a public one needs nothing.
                                                                Leave a box blank to inherit the goal
                                                                above; type 0 to exempt that tracker
                                                                from it. Pack hrs is the longer window
                                                                season packs get (blank = same as Hours).
                                                            
                                                            

                                                                Click Load indexers to list
                                                                    the torrent indexers from Prowlarr.
                                                            

                                                        

                                                    

                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
                                                

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            

                                                                ⬢ Usenet Downloader

                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            Where SYNCHRO.S sends NZBs once Prowlarr finds them. Pick one
                                                            usenet downloader. SABnzbd uses an API key for auth; NZBGet
                                                            uses a username + password.
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            

                                                                SABnzbd: default WebUI port 8080. NZBGet: default WebUI
                                                                port 6789.
                                                            

                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            

                                                                SABnzbd → Config → General → API Key. Used by SABnzbd
                                                                only.
                                                            

                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            

                                                                SYNCHRO.S tags every NZB with this category so it ends up
                                                                in a predictable post-processing folder.
                                                            

                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            

                                                                Where SYNCHRO.S can read finished NZB
                                                                downloads — its own in-container path. Set this when
                                                                SABnzbd/NZBGet writes that category to a folder (e.g.
                                                                /data/downloads/music) mounted here at a
                                                                different path. SYNCHRO.S finds the release by name under
                                                                this folder. Blank = use the Soulseek download/transfer
                                                                folders.
                                                            

                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            

                                                                
                                                                
                                                            

                                                        

                                                    

                                                

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                                

                                                    
Source

                                                    
                                                

                                                
                                                
                                                
                                            

                                            

                                            

                                        

                                    



                                    
                                    
                                    

                                        


                                            
                                            
                                            

                                                

                                                    ▼
                                                    
Music Quality

                                                    Profile
                                                    Format priorities, bitrate, bit
                                                        depth
                                                

                                                


                                                    
                                                    


                                                        
                                                        

                                                            
                                                            

                                                                
                                                                
                                                                
                                                            

                                                            

                                                                
                                                                    Edits below are saved per preset — switch
                                                                    away and back and your
                                                                    changes are still there.
                                                                
                                                                
                                                            

                                                        


                                                        
                                                        

                                                            

                                                                
                                                                i
                                                            

                                                            

                                                                How it works: Each download source is
                                                                checked against this list
                                                                top-down. The first target a source can satisfy wins; a
                                                                source that meets no target
                                                                is skipped for the next one (source priority still
                                                                decides between sources that can).
                                                                For lossless, bit depth + sample rate decide the match.
                                                                For MP3/AAC the bitrate is a
                                                                minimum threshold (≥), so VBR and mono files
                                                                aren't falsely rejected. After
                                                                download the real file is verified against the same
                                                                list. With fallback off, a track
                                                                is left missing rather than accepting a quality below
                                                                every target.
                                                                


                                                                Acquisition vs retained output:
                                                                Downsample and Lossy Copy run only
                                                                after the downloaded file passes this gate. SYNCHRO.S
                                                                remembers the acquired quality,
                                                                so intentionally retaining 16/44.1 or a lossy-only
                                                                output does not make the same track
                                                                appear as an upgrade again.
                                                            

                                                            

                                                                
                                                            


                                                            
                                                            

                                                                
                                                                
                                                                    
                                                                    
                                                                
                                                                
                                                                    
                                                                    
                                                                
                                                                
                                                            

                                                        


                                                        
                                                        

                                                            

                                                                
                                                                i
                                                            

                                                            
                                                            

                                                                
                                                                
                                                            

                                                            

                                                                Any accepted target stops upgrade
                                                                findings as soon as a file matches any target in the
                                                                list.
                                                                


                                                                Selected target or better keeps the
                                                                Quality Upgrade job proposing replacements until the
                                                                file reaches the selected rank.
                                                            

                                                        


                                                        
                                                        

                                                            

                                                                
                                                                i
                                                            

                                                            
                                                            

                                                                Source priority goes through your
                                                                sources in order and
                                                                downloads from the first one that has the
                                                                track. Fastest, fewest
                                                                lookups.


                                                                Best quality asks every
                                                                source, then downloads the
                                                                highest-quality copy it found — even if a faster source
                                                                also had a lower-quality
                                                                one. Slower and more API calls, but you never settle for
                                                                a worse file when a
                                                                better one exists.


                                                                Either way, the per-source retry limits stay the same.
                                                            

                                                        


                                                        
                                                        

                                                            

                                                                
                                                                i
                                                            

                                                            

                                                                A single source often returns several copies of the same
                                                                track.


                                                                Off (default): the most likely-correct
                                                                / fastest copy is
                                                                downloaded first — the original behaviour.


                                                                On: the highest-quality copy (per your
                                                                target list above) is
                                                                downloaded first instead; correctness and speed only
                                                                break ties.


                                                                Nothing is skipped and the source order doesn't change,
                                                                so a track can't go
                                                                missing — it just prefers the better copy. (This is
                                                                always how
                                                                Best quality works, which is why this
                                                                option only appears for
                                                                Source priority.)
                                                            

                                                        


                                                        
                                                        

                                                            

                                                                
                                                                i
                                                            

                                                            

                                                                This does not mean "walk down my list"
                                                                — the list already
                                                                does that on its own.


                                                                When on, a file that matches
                                                                none of your targets
                                                                (e.g. a 16-bit FLAC or an MP3 when you only listed
                                                                24-bit) is
                                                                accepted anyway as a last
                                                                resort.


                                                                Turn it off to strictly enforce your
                                                                list — anything off-list
                                                                is then quarantined instead of completed.
                                                            

                                                        


                                                    


                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                ▼
                                                
Quality on Import

                                                Profile
                                                Apply the profile to manually
                                                    imported files
                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            When importing from Staging, if a track already exists in
                                                            your library at a lower quality
                                                            (e.g. MP3), it will be replaced with the higher quality
                                                            version (e.g. FLAC).
                                                            If disabled, existing tracks are always kept and the import
                                                            file is skipped.
                                                            


                                                            Note: imported files are always checked
                                                            against your Quality Profile's
                                                            priority list above — there's no separate on/off switch for
                                                            that, since an empty list
                                                            (or Fallback turned on) already means "accept anything."
                                                        

                                                    

                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                ▼
                                                
Album Releases

                                                Profile
                                                What to import when a Usenet or
                                                    torrent download is a whole album
                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        
                                                        

                                                            A requested track often arrives inside a whole album release.
                                                            Requested tracks only imports just the track you asked for.
                                                            


                                                            Also the album's other tracks then imports every other
                                                            track of that album found in the release and not yet in your library.
                                                            Each one goes through the normal import pipeline with this quality
                                                            profile, like a wishlist download: a track that fails a check is
                                                            quarantined on its own, and the tracks that pass are imported.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                ▼
                                                
Post-Download Conversion

                                                Profile
                                                Downsample hi-res, make lossy
                                                    copies
                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        
When a 24-bit or high
                                                            sample-rate FLAC is downloaded, it is automatically
                                                            converted to 16-bit/44.1kHz. The hi-res original is
                                                            replaced, not kept alongside. Its acquired quality is remembered for upgrade decisions, preventing a
                                                            download/downsample loop. Requires ffmpeg.

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        
After downloading a
                                                            lossless file, a lossy derivative at the selected codec and
                                                            bitrate is created in the same folder. When the source is
                                                            kept, it remains the canonical quality and the derivative is
                                                            treated as a companion version. Requires ffmpeg.

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            Warning: each lossless original is deleted once its lossy
                                                            copy is checked (it plays, and lasts as long as the
                                                            original). New downloads: deleted for good, each one listed
                                                            in Activity. Files already in your library: the Lossy
                                                            Converter's Convert shows the list first and sends them to
                                                            the recycle bin. Turning this on asks you to confirm.
                                                            Its acquisition quality remains recorded, so this retention
                                                            choice is not shown as a new upgrade.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        One profile, two decisions: the quality list
                                                        controls what SYNCHRO.S acquires;
                                                        these options control what it retains. A retained lossless +
                                                        lossy pair is one track with two
                                                        file versions, not two duplicate tracks.
                                                    

                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                ▼
                                                
Audio Verification

                                                Profile
                                                AcoustID identity match +
                                                    truncated/silent detection
                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            Applies to both imports and
                                                            downloads. When
                                                            on, a track that AcoustID runs but
                                                            cannot confirm
                                                            (no fingerprint match / cross-script metadata — the ⚠
                                                            "unverified" case) is
                                                            quarantined instead of being allowed into
                                                            the library. Downloads then
                                                            try the next candidate; imports just quarantine (no
                                                            candidate to retry). Only a clean
                                                            AcoustID pass is kept.
                                                            


                                                            ⚠️ Use with care. AcoustID "could not
                                                            confirm" is common
                                                            for perfectly good tracks — anything not in its fingerprint
                                                            database: new/obscure
                                                            releases, classical, remixes, live cuts, remasters,
                                                            non-Latin-script titles. With
                                                            this on, all of those get quarantined, so
                                                            you may end up with many
                                                            legitimate files to review and approve by hand. Nothing is
                                                            lost (quarantined files
                                                            can be approved), but expect manual cleanup. Leave this
                                                            off to keep
                                                            the safer default: unconfirmed tracks import with the ⚠
                                                            "unverified" badge so you can
                                                            review them without anything being blocked. Transient lookup
                                                            errors (rate-limit /
                                                            outage) always import, so an AcoustID outage never stalls
                                                            you. Requires AcoustID enabled.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        
Decodes every downloaded
                                                            file with ffmpeg to catch fake 30s previews padded to full
                                                            length and mostly-silent files — the kind whose header lies
                                                            about the length so mutagen can't catch them. Off by
                                                                default: this fully decodes each file, the most
                                                            CPU-heavy post-processing step. Most sources (HiFi, Qobuz)
                                                            already catch previews on their own, so only turn this on if
                                                            you see padded/silent files slip through. Applies to all
                                                            download sources.

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            i
                                                        

                                                        
Opt-in second integrity
                                                            tier: a FLAC that passes the size/parse/duration checks is
                                                            fully decoded with flac -t, which also verifies
                                                            the STREAMINFO MD5. A file that fails is quarantined and
                                                            the next candidate is tried, so a damaged replacement can
                                                            never take the place of a good file. Off by
                                                                default. Fails open — if the flac binary is
                                                            missing or the check times out, the file is left alone
                                                            rather than quarantined.

                                                    

                                                

                                            


                                        


                                        
                                        

                                            

                                                
Quality Profiles

                                                
                                            

                                            
Click a profile's name to view/edit its
                                                settings on the left. Changes autosave to that profile, and Save
                                                Settings saves it too; viewing never activates it. Per row: ● set as
                                                active default, ✏ rename, ✎ save now, ⇩ use for Auto-Import, × delete.
                                            

                                            

                                                Editing this profile —
                                                not the active default. Changes autosave to this profile; Save Settings saves it too.
                                            

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                
                                            

                                        


                                    


                                    

                                    
                                    
                                    

                                        

                                            ▼
                                            
Download Behaviour

                                            Preview source, concurrency &
                                                timeouts
                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        

                                                            Where to stream audio when previewing tracks. YouTube is
                                                            instant and requires no setup.
                                                            "Active Download Source" uses your configured source (Tidal,
                                                            Qobuz, etc.) — if that's Soulseek, YouTube is used
                                                            automatically.
                                                            "Deezer 30s Preview" plays Deezer's 30 second clip of the
                                                            song straight away, no Deezer account needed. Songs Deezer
                                                            has no clip for use YouTube. With queue auto-download off,
                                                            missing queue songs play their clip instead of being
                                                            skipped.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        

                                                            Maximum simultaneous downloads per batch. Soulseek album
                                                            downloads always use 1 worker
                                                            due to per-user upload limits. Higher values speed up large
                                                            playlists and wishlists.
                                                            Takes effect after a restart, since the worker threads are
                                                            created at startup.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        

                                                            How long to wait on a streaming source's API during search
                                                            (HiFi, Qobuz, Deezer, and the stream preview search).
                                                            0 (or blank) = each source's built-in
                                                                default — HiFi/Qobuz 15s, Deezer 10s. Raise it
                                                            if a slow
                                                            connection makes searches give up too early; lower means
                                                            failing over to the next source faster. Clamped to
                                                            5–120.
                                                            Soulseek is not affected — it has its own Search Timeout
                                                            setting above.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        Checks
                                                            every selected source & configured connection.
                                                    

                                                

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
Retry Logic

                                        What happens when a download is
                                            rejected
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
Controls what happens when a
                                                    downloaded file is rejected (AcoustID mismatch, wrong version, or
                                                    duration/integrity failure) — independent of post-processing. When
                                                    on, SYNCHRO.S automatically tries the next-best candidate instead of
                                                    failing the track. Off = quarantine and fail
                                                    immediately.

                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
Give every source (Soulseek, then
                                                    HiFi/Tidal/…) its own retry budget. Each source spends queries ×
                                                        retries-per-query attempts before the track moves on. Worst
                                                    case across two sources can mean many downloads — use for
                                                    hard-to-match tracks (e.g. CJK artist names). Requires the option
                                                    above.

                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
In exhaustive mode, how many
                                                    candidates to try per search query per source. The per-source budget
                                                    is number of search queries × this value. Only used when
                                                    Exhaustive retry is on.

                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
When retries are fully exhausted
                                                    and every candidate for a track failed the
                                                    same version mismatch (e.g. only an instrumental
                                                    exists), accept the best (first-tried) one instead of leaving the
                                                    track missing. Only AcoustID is bypassed —
                                                    integrity/duration/bit-depth checks still run, so truncated or
                                                    genuinely wrong files are never let through. Off =
                                                    leave such tracks failed.

                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
How many quarantined candidates
                                                    must have failed the same version mismatch before the
                                                    last-resort acceptance kicks in. Higher = more confirmation that no
                                                    correct version exists. Only used when the option above is on.

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
Album Publishing

                                        When album downloads appear in your
                                            library
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
Off by default —
                                                    with this off, tracks appear in your library as they finish
                                                    downloading (unchanged behavior). When on, the
                                                    tracks of an album download are staged privately and only moved into
                                                    your media library once the whole album completes,
                                                    so Plex/Jellyfin/Navidrome never shows a half-loaded album while
                                                    it's still downloading. If a batch stalls or fails, its tracks stay
                                                    in staging (never your library) and the failed tracks remain
                                                    retryable in your wishlist. That private staging area is SYNCHRO.S's
                                                    own working folder,
                                                    storage/album_bundle_staging/<batch id> — it is
                                                    not the Staging path set under Library, which is a
                                                    different folder for a different job. It is emptied when the batch
                                                    finishes. If a crash leaves one behind, the next start moves
                                                    anything still holding audio into the Downloads recycle bin
                                                    (labelled “Stalled album download”) rather than deleting
                                                    it, so a stalled album is recoverable instead of gone. Only affects
                                                    full-album and wishlist-album downloads — single tracks and album
                                                    top-ups (completeness fills) are unaffected. Tracks stay on your
                                                    wishlist until the album is actually published, so an interrupted
                                                    album is always retryable.

                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
On by default, and
                                                    only relevant when album publishing above is on. If SYNCHRO.S
                                                    restarts or crashes part-way through an album, the tracks it had
                                                    already finished are left in the private staging folder, where no
                                                    media server can see them. On the next start SYNCHRO.S moves those
                                                    finished tracks into your library, and the tracks it never got to
                                                    are still on your wishlist, so the album fills itself in. Turn this
                                                    off to keep strict quarantine instead: the
                                                    interrupted album stays hidden until you deal with it by hand. Files
                                                    are never deleted either way.

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        Files & folders
                                        Where things live on disk, and how they get
                                            named
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
Folders

                                        Downloads and library locations
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        

                                            
Music foldersDownloads,
                                                    library & extra folders


                                            

                                                
Folder Paths

                                                

                                                    How files flow: Download Folder (raw downloads land
                                                    here) → post-processing
                                                    (tagging, artwork, organizing) → Music Library
                                                        Folder (their final home — point
                                                    your media server here). Keeping the two separate stops half-finished files being scanned.
                                                

                                                

                                                    Changed a folder or your docker-compose? Run
                                                        the setup check to see whether SYNCHRO.S, slskd and your media
                                                    server can all reach these folders.
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    Docker / Unraid detected: leave these as the
                                                    container-internal paths and map your
                                                    real folders in the container config — wrong values here break
                                                    downloads.
                                                

                                                

                                                    Bare metal / Proxmox LXC / systemd: there is no
                                                    container, so you're expected to
                                                    unlock these and point them at your real folders.
                                                

                                                

                                                    ⚠️ Your Music Library Folder is still the install-folder
                                                        default. Every finished
                                                    download is landing on the disk SYNCHRO.S is installed on — on a
                                                    Proxmox LXC that's typically an
                                                    8 GB root that fills until the container hangs. Unlock the
                                                    field and point it at your real
                                                    music folder.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    Where new downloads land before
                                                        processing. Match this to your slskd download folder.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    Your main music library. Finished
                                                        tracks are moved here, organized into Artist/Album
                                                        folders.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    New downloads are refused when the
                                                        download disk drops below this. Stops a full disk from hanging
                                                        the whole system (0 = off).
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    i
                                                    

                                                        Where Organize by playlist builds playlist
                                                        folders — as shortcuts into your library, so songs are never
                                                        stored twice. Keep this outside your music
                                                        library folder so your media server doesn't scan the same tracks
                                                        twice.
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    

                                                        Symlinks use almost no space. Copies are self-contained.
                                                        Symlinks fall back to copies automatically where the filesystem
                                                        can't link (Windows without privileges, some network shares,
                                                        FAT/exFAT drives).
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        

                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    

                                                        Entries become ../Artist/Album/01 - Song.flac
                                                        instead of the full path SYNCHRO.S sees, so a saved M3U still
                                                        works when the folder is opened from a network share, another
                                                        machine or a sync tool. Tracks that don't share a folder with
                                                        the playlist keep their full path, and the base path and
                                                        prefix rewrite below still apply to those.
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    i
                                                    

                                                        Optional prefix added to every track path in exported M3U files.
                                                        Use this when your media server needs absolute paths (e.g.
                                                        /mnt/music).
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    i
                                                    

                                                        Hot-swaps a path prefix on every entry when M3Us are generated,
                                                        so a playlist written inside a container
                                                        (/data/media/…) plays directly on the
                                                        machine that mounts the same storage elsewhere
                                                        (M:/media/…). Entries that don't start with
                                                        the prefix pass through unchanged. Leave both empty to disable.
                                                    

                                                

                                            

                                            

                                                
Additional Music Libraries


                                                

                                                    Your Music Library Folder above is already covered — you don't need to repeat it here.
                                                    Add entries only for extra libraries SYNCHRO.S should read
                                                    (a second collection, an archive
                                                    drive), or when your media server sees the same files at a different
                                                    path than SYNCHRO.S can.
                                                    Used for tag writing, streaming, and file detection.
                                                    Docker users: mount the extra folder(s) into the
                                                    SoulSync container with read-write access,
                                                    then add the container-side path here (e.g.
                                                    /music2).
                                                


                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                

                                            

                                            

                                                
Sample Studio Folders


                                                

                                                    Where Sample Studio saves your chops — organized
                                                    into Artist/Track folders inside the destination. The
                                                    first folder is the default; the save dialog lets
                                                    you pick a different one per chop (drums here, melodies there, a
                                                    folder per project). Keep these outside your
                                                    music library so your media server doesn't index chops as albums.
                                                    Docker users: mount the folder(s) into the
                                                    SoulSync container, then add the container-side path here.
                                                


                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                

                                            


                                        

                                        

                                            
Audiobook foldersWhere finished books live


                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    Where downloaded audiobooks are saved
                                                        and organized. Keep this separate from your music library so a
                                                        media server does not index chapter files as albums.
                                                

                                            


                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                    Children's audio plays and similar
                                                        releases are found by the music search, not the audiobook
                                                        search. Downloads by the artists listed here are filed in the
                                                        audiobooks folder above instead of the music library, and
                                                        count as owned so playlist syncs do not fetch them again.
                                                        Add an artist with Treat as audiobook on the
                                                        artist's page or in the watchlist settings. Routing only
                                                        affects new downloads; Move existing… relocates
                                                        albums already in the music library.
                                                

                                            


                                        

                                        

                                            
Podcast foldersWhere episodes live


                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    Where downloaded podcast episodes are
                                                        saved and organized.
                                                

                                            


                                        

                                        

                                            
Video foldersMovies, TV
                                                    & YouTube libraries


                                            


                                                

                                                    One shared download folder (where slskd / torrent drop files), then
                                                    a separate library folder per type — finished files are sorted to
                                                    the right one automatically. SEPARATE from your Music paths.
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
Where downloads land — point this at
                                                        the same folder as your slskd / torrent client. This is the SAME
                                                        folder as the Music side; changing it here changes it there too.
                                                    

                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
New episodes of anime shows
                                                        (series type Anime, or tagged with the Anime genre) go here
                                                        instead of the TV folder. Leave empty to keep anime with TV.
                                                    

                                                

                                                

                                                    Movies and TV folders above are the destinations for new downloads.
                                                    Add extra libraries below for existing collections on other drives.
                                                    Include those libraries in your Plex/Jellyfin scan selection. In
                                                    Docker, mount each folder at a different container path and enter
                                                    that path here; use read-write access for renaming, upgrades, and
                                                    recycling.
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                    
                                                    
Extra folders only — no need to
                                                        repeat the primary folder. Example: /media/movies2

                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                    

                                                    
                                                    
Extra folders only — no need to
                                                        repeat the primary folder. Example: /media/tv2
