Organization

                                        Naming, layout and file handling
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            
                                            
                                            
                                        

                                        

                                            
Music organizationFile
                                                    naming templates & reorganize


                                            

                                                
File Organization


                                                

                                                    
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    When a
                                                        release carries a MusicBrainz disambiguation (edition note)
                                                        and your template doesn't place
                                                        $disambiguation itself, it is added to the
                                                        album folder automatically. When a recording carries its own
                                                        disambiguation (version note, like “acoustic”)
                                                        and your template doesn't place
                                                        $track_disambiguation itself, it is added to the
                                                        track filename automatically. This keeps same-named releases
                                                        and same-titled recordings apart — turn it off and your template is
                                                        respected exactly as written.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Variables:
                                                        $albumartist, $artist,
                                                        $artistletter, $albumartistletter,
                                                        $album,
                                                        $albumtype, $title,
                                                        $track, $disc (01),
                                                        $discnum (1), $cdnum (CD01),
                                                        $year, $quality (filename only),
                                                        $disambiguation (the release's edition note, like
                                                        “baby punk version”; added to the album folder
                                                        automatically when your template leaves it out, unless
                                                        “Automatically add disambiguation”
                                                        above is turned off),
                                                        $track_disambiguation (the recording's version
                                                        note, like “acoustic”; added to the filename
                                                        automatically when your template leaves it out, unless the
                                                        same toggle above is turned off). The
                                                        three disc variables work in a folder segment as well as in the
                                                        filename and are empty on a single-disc album, so
                                                        $albumartist/$album/Disc $discnum/$track - $title
                                                        gives you a disc folder only where there is more than one disc.
                                                        Put any of them in the template and it replaces the automatic
                                                        disc folder from “Multi-Disc Folder Label” below.
                                                        Use ${var} to append text:
                                                        ${albumtype}s → Albums
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    A soundtrack
                                                        or compilation is filed as a compilation
                                                        instead of whichever contributor happened to be downloading
                                                        — without this, one guitarist featured on 45 soundtracks
                                                        collects all 45 albums. Compilations are filed with the
                                                        Compilation Path Template below, not the album one. Each track
                                                        still credits the artist who actually recorded it. A release
                                                        counts as a compilation when it
                                                        is credited to Various Artists, when the metadata source types
                                                        it one, or — when reorganizing, where the whole tracklist
                                                        is known — when three or more tracks have different
                                                        artists and none of them owns more than half the album. A
                                                        soundtrack credited to a single composer is left with that
                                                        composer. Also governs whether reorganize gives compilations
                                                        their own folder layout.
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Used instead
                                                        of the album template for soundtracks and compilations (see
                                                        “Detect multi-artist compilations” above).
                                                        Same variables as the album template; $albumartist
                                                        is the release's credit (often Various Artists) and
                                                        $artist is whoever recorded the track. To file
                                                        compilations exactly like albums, give it the same template
                                                        as the album one.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Variables:
                                                        $albumartist, $artist,
                                                        $artistletter, $albumartistletter,
                                                        $title,
                                                        $track (01), $album,
                                                        $albumtype, $year,
                                                        $quality (filename only). Use ${var}
                                                        to append text: ${albumtype}s → Singles
                                                


                                                
                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Variables: $playlist, $albumartist,
                                                        $artist, $artistletter, $title, $year, $quality (filename only).
                                                        Use ${var} to append text
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Renames the
                                                        files inside each "Organize by Playlist" folder (your real
                                                        library files are never touched). Filename only — no
                                                            folders. Variables: $position
                                                        (playlist order), $artist, $album,
                                                        $track, $title. Must include
                                                        $title and cannot contain "/". Example:
                                                        $position - $artist - $title →
                                                        01 - Daft Punk - One More Time.flac. Empty = keep
                                                        the original library filename.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Variables:
                                                        $artist, $artistletter,
                                                        $title, $year. Use ${var}
                                                        to append text. Default:
                                                        $artist/$title-video
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Variables:
                                                        $artist, $track,
                                                        $album, $chop (the save name),
                                                        $stem (drums/vocals/bass/other, empty for the
                                                        full mix). Default:
                                                        $artist/$track - $chop. Sample Studio files saved
                                                        chops inside the chosen sample folder with this layout; every
                                                        rendered file also carries its own tags. Empty segments
                                                        collapse — a chop with no album info won't leave a stray
                                                        folder. Use ${var} to append text.
                                                



                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Label for the
                                                        disc subfolder SYNCHRO.S adds automatically on a multi-disc album
                                                        (Disc 1/). Ignored when your path template already
                                                        places the disc itself with $disc,
                                                        $discnum or $cdnum — the
                                                        template wins.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    How
                                                        $albumartist resolves when a release has multiple
                                                        artists — this governs the FOLDER your music sorts into for both
                                                        albums and singles (the default templates use
                                                        $albumartist). "First Listed" uses only the primary
                                                        artist for folder names (e.g., "Larry June" instead of "Larry
                                                        June, Curren$y & The Alchemist"). Full artist list is always
                                                        preserved in file metadata tags.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    When
                                                        $artistletter is used in templates: artists
                                                        starting with digits, symbols or non-Latin scripts all sort into
                                                        a single # folder instead of one folder per
                                                        character ("365 Days" → #/, "北京" →
                                                        #/). Accented letters fold to their base letter
                                                        (Édith Piaf → E/). Off = the literal first
                                                        character, exactly as before.
                                                



                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Separator
                                                        between multiple artists in the ARTIST tag (e.g.
                                                        & matches MusicBrainz/Picard style)
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Write each
                                                        artist as a separate tag value for Navidrome/Jellyfin
                                                        multi-artist support
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Keep only
                                                        primary artist in ARTIST tag, append others as (feat. ...) in
                                                        title
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    When enabled,
                                                        the same song can be added to the wishlist from different albums
                                                        (e.g., completing a discography where albums share tracks). When
                                                        disabled, tracks with the same name and artist are
                                                        skipped.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Wing It
                                                        means a track couldn't be matched in the metadata catalogue
                                                        — these are unmatched guesses, not tracks missing from your
                                                        library. Off by default: guesses stay in the Wing It Pool for
                                                        manual review. Turn this on to let guesses be searched like
                                                        any other wishlist track.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    When you
                                                        remove or cancel a wishlist track, SYNCHRO.S remembers not to
                                                        re-add it automatically for this many days. Lower it (e.g. 7) to
                                                        give removed tracks another chance sooner.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                        Restores original path structure. Your downloads will be
                                                        organized like before.
                                                    
                                                

                                            

                                            

                                                
Library Organize

                                                
                                                

                                                    When the Library Organize tool re-matches a track, the metadata
                                                    source often
                                                    differs from files you've already organized: capitalization, release
                                                    year (a
                                                    reissue [2023] "corrected" to the source's 2020), or disc layout (a
                                                    single-disc
                                                    album matched to a deluxe 2-disc edition, stamping a bogus "0211"
                                                    prefix). With
                                                    this on (default), a title/album differing only by
                                                    letter-case, your own
                                                    album year, and a genuinely single-disc album's numbering are all
                                                    left alone —
                                                    no needless renames. Turn off to match the metadata source exactly.
                                                

                                                
                                                

                                                    When an import creates an artist folder, also write a Kodi-format
                                                    artist.nfo containing the artist's name and MusicBrainz
                                                    artist ID, so Jellyfin / Kodi / Emby identify the artist instead
                                                    of guessing by name. An existing artist.nfo with a
                                                    different ID is never overwritten. To backfill folders you
                                                    already have, run the Artist NFO Backfill repair job.
                                                

                                            


                                        

                                        

                                            
Audiobook organizationNaming, quality, tags & recycle


                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Variables:
                                                        $author, $authorletter,
                                                        $narrator, $title,
                                                        $series, $seriespos (01),
                                                        $year, $asin. Default:
                                                        $author/$series/$seriespos - $title. Books with no
                                                        series collapse the series folder and its number cleanly, the
                                                        same way podcast season folders do. Use ${var} to
                                                        append text.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Deleting a
                                                        book MOVES it to a hidden .deleted folder inside
                                                        your audiobook library instead of erasing it, so a mis-click can
                                                        be undone. The folder is hidden so Audiobookshelf, Plex and
                                                        Jellyfin do not keep showing books you removed. Note the space
                                                        is not freed until the bin is emptied. Off, deletes are
                                                        permanent immediately.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    days
                                                    i
                                                    How long a
                                                        deleted book stays recoverable before the daily cleanup erases
                                                        it for good. 0 turns the bin off — it
                                                        does not mean "erase everything now", because purging on that
                                                        reading would destroy what was recycled while the bin was still
                                                        on. Default: 7
                                                


                                                
Audiobook Quality

                                                What counts as a good file. One profile for
                                                    every audiobook — the per-author card carries the settings
                                                    that differ by author.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Ranked first
                                                        when several releases are otherwise equal; the rest keep their
                                                        usual order behind it. M4B is the only format
                                                        built for audiobooks — chapters, bookmarks, and one file
                                                        instead of ninety. Pick MP3 if your player
                                                        cannot read M4B. Format never outweighs having the right book
                                                        and the right narrator.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                        
                                                        
                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    i
                                                    Releases in a
                                                        format that is switched off are never shown or downloaded.
                                                        Preferred Format only ranks, so with M4B preferred an MP3 is
                                                        still grabbed when no M4B turns up; switch MP3 off here to
                                                        wait for an M4B instead. A release whose format cannot be told
                                                        from its title is still allowed. Switching every format off is
                                                        the same as allowing them all.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    i
                                                    Whether a book
                                                        should arrive as one file or as several
                                                        smaller files, usually one per chapter. Switch one off and
                                                        releases laid out that way are skipped; leave both on (or both off) for
                                                        either. Only Soulseek says how many files a release has before it is
                                                        downloaded; torrents and usenet do not, so they are always allowed.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    kbps
                                                    i
                                                    Hides releases
                                                        below this bitrate. 0 means no opinion. This is
                                                        taste, and separate from the completeness floor above: that one
                                                        asks whether a release could be the whole book at all, this one
                                                        asks whether you want it. Audible's own files are 32 kbps mono
                                                        and 64 kbps stereo, so 32 is a reasonable floor and anything
                                                        above 128 is more than speech needs.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    kbps
                                                    i
                                                    Hides releases
                                                        above this bitrate, for when disk space matters more than
                                                        headroom. 0 means no opinion. Speech gains
                                                        nothing audible above about 128 kbps, so a 45-hour book at 240
                                                        kbps is roughly 4GB for no benefit.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    GraphicAudio
                                                        and similar full-cast productions with music and sound effects.
                                                        They are a different product from the audiobook —
                                                        different cast, different running time, usually sold in several
                                                        separately-downloaded parts. Left on they are shown but ranked
                                                        below real readings and clearly labelled; turned off they are
                                                        hidden entirely.
                                                


                                                
Downloads & Import

                                                Books use the same torrent, usenet and Soulseek
                                                        clients as music — set those up under Sources.

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Which Audible
                                                        storefront the audiobook catalogue pages, author scans and
                                                        follow checks query. Some titles are exclusive to one country's
                                                        store, so picking the store you buy from finds books the US
                                                        store never lists. Default: us
                                                


                                                
                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Which sources
                                                        a book search asks. Separate from the music chain on purpose
                                                        — Tidal, Qobuz, HiFi and Deezer carry no
                                                        audiobooks at all, so a book on the music chain would burn an
                                                        attempt on each of them before it could succeed. The clients
                                                        themselves are the same ones music uses; only the order and the
                                                        category differ.
                                                


                                                
                                                

                                                    

                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    The category
                                                        SYNCHRO.S tags audiobook torrents and NZBs with in your download
                                                        client. Keep it different from your music category so a finished
                                                        book is never picked up by anything watching for music. Default:
                                                        audiobooks
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Newznab
                                                        category IDs searched for audiobooks. 3030 is the
                                                        standard audiobook category and is deliberately kept OUT of
                                                        music searches, so asking for it here costs the music side
                                                        nothing. Only change this if your indexer uses a non-standard
                                                        ID.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    %
                                                    i
                                                    How much of
                                                        the runtime Audible publishes has to actually be on disk before
                                                        a book is filed into your library. A download client reports
                                                        "complete" when the files it was asked for finished,
                                                        which is not the same as the book being whole — and a book
                                                        missing its last chapters plays perfectly until you run out of
                                                        it. Short books are held in staging, never failed outright.
                                                        Default: 92
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    days
                                                    i
                                                    How long an
                                                        incomplete book is kept staged before it is failed and sent back
                                                        to the wishlist. Torrents finish late and uploaders repair
                                                        releases, so patience is right here; forever would mean one
                                                        broken release holds a wishlist row for good. Default:
                                                        7
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Chapter files
                                                        arrive named however the uploader left them. On by default: a
                                                        book whose files sort wrong plays wrong. Turn this off only if
                                                        you trust your releases' own numbering.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Off by
                                                        default: when a book arrives as many files, combine them into
                                                        a single .m4b with one chapter marker per file
                                                        during import. Needs ffmpeg on the server
                                                        (the Docker image ships it). The originals are only removed
                                                        after the merged file verifies, so a failed merge never
                                                        loses the book.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Off by default:
                                                        a book that is downloaded or found in your library stays on the
                                                        wishlist, marked "In library". Turn this on to drop it instead,
                                                        the way the music wishlist does.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Embeds title,
                                                        author, series and narrator into each file on import. Narrator
                                                        goes in the COMPOSER field, which is the convention every
                                                        audiobook server settled on. Without this a book keeps whatever
                                                        the uploader's ripper wrote, which is usually chapter 4 of a
                                                        27-hour book tagged as a track on an album called
                                                        "audiobook".
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Embeds the
                                                        cover into every chapter file. A cover the release already
                                                        shipped is preferred over fetching one, so this still works
                                                        offline.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Writes
                                                        cover.jpg into the book folder. Plex, Jellyfin,
                                                        Audiobookshelf and Booksonic all read it from there.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Writes
                                                        metadata.opf (Audiobookshelf, Plex, Calibre) and
                                                        book.nfo (Kodi, Jellyfin, Emby). Both, because the
                                                        servers genuinely disagree about which to look for and they are
                                                        a few hundred bytes each. These also carry the ASIN, which is
                                                        what lets the daily library scan recognise a book you imported
                                                        months ago.
                                                

                                            


                                        

                                        

                                            
Podcast organizationNaming & media format


                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Variables:
                                                        $show, $author, $title,
                                                        $season (01), $seasonnum (1),
                                                        $episode (01), $episodenum (1),
                                                        $year, $date (YYYY-MM-DD),
                                                        $type. Default:
                                                        $show/Season $season/$title. Season and episode
                                                        folders collapse cleanly if omitted in feed. Use
                                                        ${var} to append text.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    i
                                                    Choose which
                                                        formats to store in your podcast folders. Audio
                                                            Only keeps standard audio files with embedded tags.
                                                        Video Only remuxes the audio into an MP4 video
                                                        container with a static high-res episode artwork frame and
                                                        Apple/iTunes TV metadata tags so Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby can
                                                        catalog them as TV Shows with seasons, episode posters, and
                                                        playback resume. Audio & Video keeps both
                                                        formats side-by-side in the same folder with shared NFO sidecars
                                                        so both Music and TV media libraries can index the same folder
                                                        simultaneously.
                                                

                                            


                                        

                                        

                                            
Video organizationPath templates, post-processing &
                                                    recycle


                                            



                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Variables: $title, $titlefirst, $year,
                                                        $quality (e.g. Bluray-1080p), $resolution, $source, $codec,
                                                        $edition, $tmdbid, $imdbid. Folders split on "/", the last
                                                        segment is the filename.
                                                    Example: …
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Variables: $series, $season (01),
                                                        $seasonraw (1), $episode (01), $episodetitle, $year, $quality,
                                                        $resolution, $source, $codec, $tvdbid.
                                                    Example: …
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Followed YouTube channels organize as a
                                                        TV show. Variables: $channel, $year, $sxe (s2024e0315 —
                                                        lets Plex/Jellyfin index episodes without an online agent),
                                                        $date (2024-03-15), $month (03), $day (15), $title,
                                                        $videoid.
                                                    Plex tip: set the YouTube library's
                                                        agent to Personal Media Shows — episode
                                                        titles then come straight from the filename, and the channel
                                                        folder gets its poster/fanart automatically.
                                                    Example: …
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Following a channel backfills its most
                                                        recent N videos, then watches for anything new posted after you
                                                        follow. This is also the rolling "keep the last N current" net
                                                        the channel scan uses. 0 = don't backfill
                                                        anything, only grab new uploads going forward. It never pulls
                                                        the whole back catalog.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    How a finished download moves from the
                                                        download folder into your library.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Tag by the file's real resolution and
                                                        reject corrupt / sample files. Needs ffmpeg; falls back to the
                                                        release name when absent.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Deletes the old file when an upgrade
                                                        lands.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Bring sibling .srt / .ass files
                                                        alongside the video, renamed to match.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Download the full artwork set —
                                                        poster.jpg, fanart.jpg, clearlogo.png (plus season posters for
                                                        shows) — next to the movie / into the show folder. Off by
                                                        default; Plex/Jellyfin usually fetch their own once the folder
                                                        is named cleanly. Turn on to pin specific art or for
                                                        offline/local-assets setups.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Write Kodi/Jellyfin-style movie.nfo /
                                                        tvshow.nfo (title, plot, rating, genres, cast, ids) so the
                                                        library is fully portable. Off by default — Plex ignores
                                                        these, but Jellyfin/Kodi/Emby use them.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Upgrade-replaced copies,
                                                        retention-cleaned YouTube episodes and dismissed imports move
                                                        into an ss_recycle folder inside the library
                                                        instead of being deleted — a safety net if something gets
                                                        replaced by mistake.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Recycled files older than this are
                                                        removed for good (cleaned automatically as new files are
                                                        recycled).
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Set a single folder to collect
                                                        everything (keep it on the same drive as your libraries so moves
                                                        are instant). Blank = an ss_recycle folder per
                                                        library.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    New grabs are refused (and the wishlist
                                                        drains pause) when the target drive has less free space than
                                                        this — so a download can never fill the disk. 0 disables
                                                        the check.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Uses the community SponsorBlock
                                                        database at download time. Mark adds skippable
                                                        chapters (sponsor, self-promo, intro, outro);
                                                        Cut removes sponsor/self-promo/interaction
                                                        segments from the file entirely.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Embeds YouTube's subtitles (your
                                                        Subtitle Languages above) into the downloaded file so
                                                        Plex/Jellyfin offer them without sidecar files.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Restores the Radarr/Sonarr standard
                                                        layout.
                                                

                                            


                                            


                                                
Subtitles


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Fetch external .srt files next to
                                                        the video from the provider chain below, only for what's
                                                        missing. On by default for new imports — free tiers
                                                        are quota-limited (~20 downloads/day each), so anything
                                                        missed is retried later.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Language codes to fetch, in
                                                        priority order (e.g. en,es). One .srt per
                                                        language is written as
                                                        <video>.<lang>.srt.
                                                    Each code is 2–3 letters;
                                                        separate codes with commas, spaces, or semicolons.
                                                    
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    A tiebreak only, never a filter:
                                                        when two subtitles score the same, the hearing-impaired
                                                        one (sound cues, speaker names) wins.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    On top of the full track, fetch a
                                                        forced (foreign-parts-only) track per language, written as
                                                        <video>.<lang>.forced.srt — the lines
                                                        for scenes in another language, for when you watch
                                                        without full subtitles. Many titles have none, so these
                                                        often stay missing.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    Before fetching, SYNCHRO.S checks what
                                                        the video already has: any sidecar next to it
                                                        (.en.srt, .eng.srt,
                                                        .English.sdh.srt, or an unlabeled
                                                        .srt whose language it detects) and the
                                                        file's own embedded tracks.
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Ignore image subs if your players
                                                        can't show them (or have to transcode for them) and you'd
                                                        rather have a text .srt.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    After a download, shift the
                                                        subtitle timing to match the video's own audio
                                                        (ffsubsync, offline). Requires the
                                                        ffsubsync Python package on the server;
                                                        a failed sync keeps the original file.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        

                                                            

                                                                

                                                                    Available
                                                                    drag one across, or click it
                                                                

                                                                

                                                            

                                                            

                                                                

                                                                    Provider chain
                                                                    
                                                                

                                                                

                                                            

                                                        

                                                    

                                                    Each provider is tried in order,
                                                        top first, until subtitles are found. Whisper stays
                                                        pinned last as the last resort when enabled.
                                                    API keys live under
                                                        Services → OpenSubtitles, SubDL, SubSource.
                                                        Embedded needs no key.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        

                                                    

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    Last-resort fallback: when no
                                                        provider has subtitles, this server transcribes the
                                                        video's own audio — no API key, no quota, fully
                                                        offline after the one-time model download. Transcription
                                                        runs in the background subtitle worker (a 45-minute
                                                        episode takes roughly 10–20 minutes on a typical
                                                        CPU). Requires the
                                                        faster-whisper Python package on the
                                                        server.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            Candidates scoring below this are a miss and never download.
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            Max subtitle downloads per provider per day (UTC).
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            A new candidate must beat the current subtitle by this much to replace it.
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            How often the wanted loop retries misses.
                                                        

                                                        

                                                            
                                                            
                                                            Max wanted rows attempted per worker cycle.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                    

                                                    
                                                    New imports are covered
                                                        automatically. The Missing Subtitles job on the Tools
                                                        page checks everything you already own on a schedule
                                                        and queues what's missing; turn on its Dry Run to
                                                        review findings first.
                                                

                                            


                                        

                                    




                                    
                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
DJ

                                        Between tracks, BPM, key and energy, beat grids
                                    

                                    

                                        
                                        

                                            

                                        

                                        

                                            
BPM, key and energy

                                            
                                            

                                                SYNCHRO.S listens to every track in your library, one at a
                                                time in the background, and works out its tempo, its key
                                                (shown in Camelot notation, like 8A) and an energy level
                                                from 1 to 10. It goes gently: it pauses while a download or
                                                an import is running, and Activity shows how far it has got,
                                                with Stop. A BPM or key already in a file's tags, or from
                                                your metadata source, is kept.
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                So Traktor, Rekordbox, Serato and Mixxx read them. Only
                                                files that have no BPM or key get one; a value already in a
                                                file stays. A key SYNCHRO.S isn't sure of is never written.
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                Off unless you want SYNCHRO.S's own values everywhere,
                                                including over what another app wrote.
                                            

                                        

                                        
                                        

                                            
Mix tab

                                            
                                            

                                                The player's Mix mode (key M), the phone's Mix and Set
                                                tabs, and "Mixes well with…" in a track's "…". Off for
                                                now while mixing is being rethought. Sets, Up next,
                                                Between tracks and Play as a mix work either way.

Post-Processing

Core Features

                                                    

                                                        
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        Higher
                                                            resolution but quality may vary. When off, uses
                                                            Spotify/iTunes/Deezer art (consistent 640x640). Ignored when
                                                            a preferred album art source list is set below — add Cover
                                                            Art Archive to that list instead.
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        Order the
                                                            sources to choose whose cover art is used. The first source
                                                            that has a cover wins; misses fall through to the next, and
                                                            if none match, your download's own art is kept. Only sources
                                                            you're connected to are shown — leave all off to keep
                                                            current behavior.
                                                        

                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        When a
                                                            track matches a single release, look up the album that
                                                            contains it and tag it as that album — so every song in an
                                                            album gets the same (album) cover instead of some getting
                                                            the single's art. Off by default: adds an extra metadata
                                                            lookup per single-matched track.
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        Analyzes
                                                            loudness and writes ReplayGain track gain/peak tags.
                                                            Requires ffmpeg. Adds a few seconds per track.
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                        i
                                                        Maximum
                                                            drift between the file's actual length and the metadata
                                                            source's expected length before the file is quarantined.
                                                            0 = auto: files can run 3s short (5s for
                                                            tracks >10min) or 15s long. Raise this if tracks
                                                            routinely quarantine for being a few seconds off (live
                                                            recordings, alternate masterings, CD pregaps). A set value
                                                            applies both ways, so anything under 15 also tightens the
                                                            long side. Capped at 60s.

Import

                                        Folder-artist override, permanent
                                            library
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                

                                                    On by default (legacy behaviour). When enabled, files staged as
                                                    Artist/Album/… (or Artist/Albums/Album/…)
                                                    take the top
                                                    folder as the album artist — handy for mixtapes/compilations whose
                                                    embedded tags
                                                    carry DJ names. Turn this off if you drop a mixed
                                                    pile of songs
                                                    under one container folder: otherwise every file's artist gets
                                                    overwritten with
                                                    that folder's name (the cause of the "soulsync" mass-mislabel). With
                                                    it off, the
                                                    metadata-identified artist is always kept.
                                                

                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                

                                                    On by default for new installs. Turn this off if
                                                    your Music Library
                                                    folder is just a scratch
                                                    drop area rather than your real, permanent library (served by
                                                    Navidrome/Plex/etc.). A Deep Scan then never relocates files it
                                                    doesn't
                                                    recognize out to
                                                    Staging — it leaves them in place and just reports them. Even with
                                                    this off, a
                                                    Deep Scan now refuses to move files when the database looks badly
                                                    out of sync
                                                    with disk, as a safety guard against wiping a library (issue #904).
