Filtering

                                        Explicit content
                                            & genre whitelist
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                                i
                                            

                                            

                                                When disabled, tracks marked as explicit on Spotify will be skipped
                                                during matched downloads. Does not affect manual Soulseek searches.
                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
                                                i
                                            

                                            

                                                When picking between Soulseek results, files marked Explicit/Uncensored
                                                rank higher and Clean/Censored/Radio-Edit files rank lower. Nothing is
                                                ever skipped — if only a clean version exists, it still downloads.
                                                Requires explicit content to be allowed.
                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                
                                                
0 disables the limit. At 10 MB/min, a 3:30 track
                                                    may be up to 35 MB (1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes).
                                                    Oversized candidates are skipped before download. Uses the
                                                    advertised duration, or the requested track length when unavailable.
                                                    Album releases use the album length. Sources without size or
                                                    duration information cannot be checked.
                                                    This does not resize existing files or limit post-processing output.
                                                

                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                
                                                i
                                            

                                            

                                                Spotify often only carries one cut of a track. With a version picked
                                                here,
                                                a matching file wins over the plain one when both turn up in the same
                                                Soulseek search. Nothing is ever skipped — if that version isn't
                                                out
                                                there, the normal one downloads exactly as it does now. Off by default.
                                                


                                                Live, remix, acoustic and instrumental files are normally thrown out on
                                                sight when the source didn't ask for one. Picking any of those four here
                                                lifts that for the version you picked, so a live take of a similarly
                                                titled song can be accepted when the real track is nowhere to be found.
                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                i
                                            

                                            

                                                When enabled, only genres on the whitelist below are kept during
                                                enrichment. Junk tags (artist names, radio shows, playlist names) are
                                                silently dropped. When disabled, all genres pass through unchanged.

Playlists

                                        M3U export &
                                            server playlist sync
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                                i
                                            

                                            

                                                Saves an M3U playlist file alongside your music. Albums are skipped —
                                                they're already grouped by your media server.
                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                i
                                            

                                            

                                                Keeps a single soulsync_library.m3u of your entire library,
                                                rewritten after every scan (deep, incremental, or full refresh) so it
                                                stays in sync with the database.
                                            

                                            

                                                
                                                
                                                i
                                                

                                                    Where the whole-library M3U is written. Leave empty to use your
                                                    Music Library folder.
                                                

                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                
                                                i
                                                

                                                    "Replace" deletes and recreates the server playlist every sync,
                                                    which wipes its custom image/description. "Reconcile" updates the
                                                    same playlist in place (adds new tracks, removes ones no longer in
                                                    the source) so your custom image and description survive. "Append"
                                                    only ever adds.
                                                

                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                i
                                                

                                                    When on, syncing a playlist adds tracks missing from your
                                                    library to the wishlist (which queues them for download).
                                                    Turn it off and syncs skip the wishlist step — missing tracks
                                                    are never added to the wishlist. (A playlist's own
                                                    organize/folder-download setting is separate and still
                                                    applies.) The Sync / Sync + download buttons always choose
                                                    per click, regardless of this setting.
                                                

                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                i
                                                

                                                    Replace deletes the playlist on your media server and rebuilds it.
                                                    This copies the old server playlist first, so anything you added to
                                                    it on the server isn't lost. SYNCHRO.S already keeps its own copy of
                                                    the source playlist, so turn this off if you don't edit playlists on
                                                    the server. Reconcile and Append edit in place, so they normally skip it.

Security & Access

                                        PIN · user accounts · reverse proxy
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                By default, anyone who can reach SYNCHRO.S on your network can use it.
                                                Protect access below with a simple shared PIN, or full
                                                user accounts with passwords — you only need one. The
                                                last group is just for exposing SYNCHRO.S over the internet.
                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
🔑 Lock with a PIN simple · one shared PIN
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        Set a PIN before you can turn on the lock screen.
                                                    

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        A lock screen appears on every page load, verified against the
                                                        admin PIN. Closing the tab requires re-entry.
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
👤 User accounts (login) per-person · best for public
                                                        access

                                                

                                                    Everyone signs in with their account name + password. Turning this
                                                    on replaces the PIN and the profile picker. Set
                                                    passwords for other people in Manage Profiles.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
✓ A
                                                        login password is set

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        So you can reset a forgotten password by answering it on the
                                                        sign-in screen.
                                                    

                                                    

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        Replaces the profile picker + PIN with a sign-in screen. Best
                                                        for instances exposed to the internet.
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        Adds a "Sign in with Plex" button to the sign-in screen. Anyone
                                                        with access to your Plex server signs in with their Plex account
                                                        (SYNCHRO.S never sees their password), and their playlists sync to
                                                        their own Plex account. The server's owner signs in as the admin.
                                                        New Plex profiles start with what New sign-ups below sets;
                                                        widen them per person under Profiles.
                                                        Needs Plex as a media server and internet access to plex.tv.
                                                    

                                                    
                                                    
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                        What a profile made by sign-in can open. Music: Discover, Search,
                                                        Library, Wishlist and Stats. Movies & TV: Discover, Search and
                                                        Library on the video side. Request-only profiles also get Requests.
                                                        Help and Issues are always there; widen anyone further under
                                                        Profiles.
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        
                                                        requests every
                                                        
                                                        days
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        0 means no limit. A request is one movie, show, album or track.
                                                        Applies to profiles made after you save; change existing ones
                                                        under Profiles.
                                                    

                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
🌐 Reverse proxy & remote access

                                                

                                                    Only needed if you expose SYNCHRO.S to the internet behind nginx /
                                                    Caddy / Traefik. See Support/REVERSE-PROXY.md.
                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    

                                                        Trusts the proxy's X-Forwarded-* headers, marks the
                                                        session cookie HTTPS-only, and adds security headers.
                                                        Leave OFF for direct / LAN access over http://
                                                        — it would otherwise break plain-HTTP login. Takes
                                                            effect after a restart.
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                        If an auth proxy (Authelia / Authentik / oauth2-proxy) logs
                                                        users in in front of SYNCHRO.S, enter the header it sets and
                                                        SYNCHRO.S trusts it. Only set this behind a proxy that
                                                            strips any client-supplied copy of the header.
                                                        Blank = off.
                                                    

                                                


                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                        Origins (full URL, no trailing slash) allowed to open WebSocket
                                                        connections — one per line or comma-separated. Empty =
                                                        same-origin only (the secure default; fine for direct access and
                                                        most reverse-proxy setups). Add your public domain if live
                                                        updates fail behind a proxy. * on its own line
                                                        allows any origin (insecure).

                                                Compact Database rewrites the entire DB to reclaim

REST API Keys

                                                

                                                    Generate API keys to access SYNCHRO.S remotely via the
                                                    /api/v1/ endpoints.
                                                    Keys are shown once at creation — store them securely.
                                                


                                                
                                                

                                                    

                                                        Loading...

                                                


                                                
                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                        A read-only key can fetch library and status data. It cannot
                                                        change anything or read settings, keys or profiles.
                                                    

                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                


                                                
                                                

                                                    

                                                        Copy this key now — it won't be shown again!
                                                    

                                                    

                                                        
                                                        
                                                    

                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
Inbound Request
                                                    Endpoint

                                                

                                                    Trigger music downloads from external tools (Discord bots, Home
                                                    Assistant, curl, etc.)
                                                    using any API key above.
                                                

                                                

                                                    curl -X POST http://<host>:8008/api/v1/request \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "Artist - Track Name"}'
                                                

                                                

                                                    Returns a request_id for status polling. Add
                                                    "notify_url" to POST results to a webhook on
                                                    completion.
                                                    Also triggers any Webhook Received automations in
                                                    the Automation Hub.
                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
MCP for AI
                                                    Clients

                                                

                                                    Lets Claude and other AI apps search, check your library and
                                                    download through SYNCHRO.S. Add
                                                    http://<host>:8008/mcp as an MCP server and
                                                    send an API key from above as a Bearer token. A read-only key
                                                    can look but not change anything. Settings, keys and profiles
                                                    are never reachable.
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                

                                            


                                            
                                            

                                                
Lidarr Compatible
                                                    API

                                                

                                                    Lets request apps that only talk to Lidarr (Singarr, MusicSeerr
                                                    1.x) use SYNCHRO.S instead. In the app, set the Lidarr URL to
                                                    http://<host>:8008/lidarr and paste an
                                                    Admin API key from above. Albums it asks for
                                                    go on the wishlist of the profile below.
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                

                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    

                                                        Pick a profile without download rights and every request
                                                        waits for approval on the Requests page first.

                                                Off by default. When on, SYNCHRO.S resizes art server-side so a grid of
                                                tiles
                                                doesn't pull full-size originals — the big win on large libraries, at
                                                the cost
                                                of some CPU the first time each image is seen. Everything else about the
                                                cache
                                                is unchanged.
                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Nothing here is irreplaceable — every image is re-downloaded on demand,
                                                so
                                                clearing only costs a slower first load.
                                            

                                            

                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
Sidebar Weather

                                        Time, temp & forecast line
                                    

                                    

                                        


                                            

                                                
                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                

                                                

                                                    No API keys, no setup beyond this — the server looks up the
                                                    location and fetches the forecast (Open-Meteo, cached 30 min).
                                                    Clear to turn the feature off.
                                                

                                            


                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Master switch for the weather line, forecast popover and particle
                                                scene. The scene also respects your OS "reduce motion" setting.
                                            


                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year's and Lunar New Year
                                                in the sidebar around each, by your location's date. Christmas Day
                                                always snows.
                                            


                                            

                                                
                                            

                                            

                                                Auto-detected from the location (°F for US, °C elsewhere) —
                                                flip it here if you prefer the other.
                                            


                                            

                                                
                                                Loading...
                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
Developer

                                        Preview tools, nothing saved
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                

                                                

                                                    Shows any sky or holiday in the sidebar so you can check how it
                                                    looks. Only this browser tab sees it and nothing is saved; the
                                                    weather line reads "Preview" while it's on. The date pretends
                                                    it's another day, which sets the season and the holiday.
                                                

                                            

                                            

                                                
                                                Live weather
                                            

                                            

                                                
                                                

                                                    
                                                    
                                                    
                                                

                                                

                                                    Runs the real first-run setup over the app. Nothing is saved:
                                                    settings, the profile, follows and sign-ins stay in the preview
                                                    and are thrown away when you close it. Connection checks still
                                                    talk to the real services, read only. A Preview tag stays in the
                                                    corner the whole time.

Notifications

                                        Discord, webhooks & Telegram
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                Video downloads from slskd, torrent or usenet only. Hybrid tries each
                                                enabled source in order.
                                            

                                            

                                                
                                                
                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
Use the arrows
                                                    to order sources. Enable the ones you want — downloads try each
                                                    enabled source in order.

                                                

                                            

                                            

                                            
                                            

                                                
                                                
                                                    Get told when things happen — a Discord webhook, any generic webhook
                                                    (raw JSON), or a Telegram bot.
                                                    Each connection picks which events it cares about.
                                                
                                                

                                                
                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    
                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
Import Lists

                                        Auto-add movies & shows from a
                                            list
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                
                                                
                                                    Everything on a list enters acquisition automatically (movies →
                                                    wishlist, shows → follow with the chosen monitor policy).
                                                    Only NEW list members are added, so removing something never
                                                    boomerangs back. Synced by the "Sync Import Lists" automation.
                                                    Ref: a TMDB list id, a chart key (trending_movies, top_shows, …), an
                                                    IMDb ls-id/URL — Plex Watchlist needs no ref.
                                                
                                                

                                                
                                            

                                        

                                    


                                    

                                        ▼
                                        
Experimental

                                        Opt-in preview features
                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
Features in this section are
                                                optional, may change without notice, and are not held to the same
                                                support standard as core metadata sources.

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
Exposes JioSaavn
                                                    as a primary metadata source on the Connections tab and in search.
                                                    Free, no account — strong for Indian and Bollywood catalogs; limited
                                                    to 1 request/sec via the public proxy API. Off by default.

                                            

                                            

                                                

                                                    
                                                    i
                                                

                                                
Adds Bandcamp as
                                                    a Discover search source and a track/album metadata enrichment
                                                    source (tags, label, credits). Free, no account — uses Bandcamp's
                                                    own public search and release-page endpoints (unofficial, no
                                                    guaranteed uptime or rate limits). Off by default.

                                            

                                        

                                    

                                

                            


                            
                            

                                

                                    
Accent colour

                                    
One colour for buttons, links, selected rows and
                                        focus. SYNCHRO.S makes a lighter shade of it for text and fills, so every
                                        preset reads well on the dark ground. Yours only; each profile picks its
                                        own.

                                    
                                    

                                        
                                        
                                        
                                    

                                    
                                    

                                


                                

                                    

                                        
Theme

                                        
Dark only for now. The near-black ground and
                                            white-wash surfaces are what the accent is tuned against.

                                    

                                    Dark
                                


                                

                                    
Motion and effects

                                    
Particles and worker orbs are on or off for
                                        everyone. Reduce visual effects and Max performance are remembered on
                                        each device.

Off by default: they use the graphics card.

Desktop only.

                                                    heavy parts for the graphics card. Loading spinners keep
                                                    moving. Good for low-end devices.
                                            

                                            
                                        

                                        

                                            

                                                
                                                For setups without a graphics
                                                    card (Docker, remote desktop): turns off worker orbs,
                                                    particles, blur, shadows and every animation, spinners
                                                    included. While it's on, the three settings above are
                                                    off.
                                            

                                            
                                        

                                    

                                

                            


                            
                            

                                

                                    
Assistant

                                    
An assistant in Automations that turns a sentence into a
                                        draft automation, suggests what's worth automating and explains runs. It
                                        writes drafts only: nothing is saved, run or sent without you. It uses a
                                        cloud model with your own API key, which stays on this server, encrypted
                                        like the other secrets.

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            
                                            
Other providers can be added later.

Track identification

                                            
Works out what a station is playing: first from the
                                                station's own now-playing feed, then from the track names sent with the
                                                stream, and as a fallback from a fingerprint of a few seconds of audio
                                                (Chromaprint and AcoustID, the tools SYNCHRO.S already uses for downloaded
                                                files). With it off, stations still play, but nothing can be added to
                                                Wanted from radio.

                                        

                                        
                                    

                                    

                                    

                                        

                                            
                                            

                                                
                                                
                                            

                                            
Free, from acoustid.org. The
                                                same key the download identifier uses.

                                        

                                        

                                            
Status

                                            

                                            Run Setup check
                                        

                                    

                                


                                
                                

                                    

                                        
Scan now services

                                        
Asked when someone presses Scan now in the player or on
                                            a station page, in this order, stopping at the first match. AudD can also
                                            listen on its own when a station doesn't say what's playing (below).
                                            AcoustID is free; AudD and ACRCloud are accounts with a monthly
                                            allowance.

                                    

                                    
    
                                    
    
                                        
    
                                            
    Listen automatically
                                                when the station doesn’t say

                                                name the track and AcoustID didn't know it. Up to 100 a day; Scan now by
                                                hand doesn't count.
    
                                            
    
                                        
    
                                        
    
                                            
                                            
                                        
    
                                    
    
                                    
    
                                    
    Test sends AudD or ACRCloud one second
                                        of silence and uses one request from the account's allowance; AcoustID's test is
                                        a free key check. The month's counts are requests SYNCHRO.S sent: scans, tests and
                                        automatic requests alike.

                                        These limits apply to every station that has it on. Tracks go to Wanted at your
                                        quality target; skipped if you have them or they're already there.

    Streams
    
                                    
    Your server reads each stream's track names and, when a
                                        browser can't play it directly, relays the audio. It does this only for built-in
                                        picks, directory stations and the links below, only for audio, and only while
                                        someone is listening.
    
                                    
    
                                        
                                        
                                        
                                        
    Each relayed station holds one of the server's 8 threads; two at a time.

      Modules
      
                                
      Video, Podcasts, Audiobooks, Chat & Arcade and Sample
                                    Studio are modules: optional parts of SYNCHRO.S. Turn one off and its pages leave
                                    the sidebar, its downloads and background jobs stop, and its automations are
                                    skipped. Music is always on.
      
                                
      Each switch applies as soon as you flip it. You don't
                                    need to press Save Settings.
      
                                
      Only an admin
                                    can turn modules on or off. This is what's on right now.

        Keyboard shortcuts
        
                
            
        
            
        The first group works anywhere outside a text field; the rest while the tray or the visuals are open. In the visuals, V, Shift V, R and Shift S work on the visuals; L is the A–B loop and S the star there too.
        
            
        
                
        Play or pause; stop, while a station plays
        Space
        
                
        Back or forward 5 seconds
        ← →
        
                
        Volume
        ↑ ↓
        
                
        The tray to Mix and back (Visuals: the Mix drawer); mute where there's no Mix tab
        M
        
                
        Mute
        Shift M
        
                
        Play the top match next; the next track where there's no Mix tab
        N
        
                
        Next or previous track
        Shift N P
        
                
        Add the playing track to the working set
        A
        
                
        Star or unstar the playing track (the focused row's, on a list)
        S
        
                
        Mix now, into the next track on the next phrase (Auto mix on)
        X
        
                
        A–B loop
        L
        
                
        Slower or faster
        [ ]
        
                
        Visuals
        F
        
                
        This list
        ?
        
                
        Next or previous visual
        V Shift V
        
                
        A random visual
        R
        
                
        Favourite this MilkDrop preset
        Shift S
        
                
        Close the panel, then the visuals, then collapse the tray
        Esc
